description: Activate when: user says 'what does this role do once the agent takes over?', 'how should KPIs change after AI goes live?', 'what new skills do our people need?', 'how do we tell the team about AI replacing work?', 'rewrite the job description for AI', or an agent has already taken over part of a role's tasks. Do NOT activate when: it has not yet been decided which tasks go to the agent (run a task-delegability assessment first); the question is purely a headcount-reduction cost calculation; the change itself needs leading across the organization (use kotter-change). More: deciqai.com/c/human-ai-role-redesign

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent apply safe operational sequencing and rollback awareness?
Did the agent verify final system state with concrete evidence?
